item.title: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say the fie
item.description: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say the field at Iolcus ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr. They say the Theriodai of Field of Ares were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold."
